narrative:
The inventory optimization analysis for material PL3__M1B41D26 reveals a smooth demand pattern with moderate variability (CV=0.309). 
The analysis is based on 175 working days with an average daily demand of 482 units. 

Lead time analysis shows volatile behavior with a mean of 1.52 days and CV of 0.702, 
requiring an effective lead time buffer of 3.13 days.

The recommended safety stock of 900 units provides 95% service level protection against demand and lead time variability. 
The storage capacity constraint (4512 units) limits the order quantity to 3611 units, 
down from the unconstrained EOQ of 7226 units.

The recommended policy is projected to reduce annual costs by $5,206 (60.2%) compared to 
the current policy, primarily through reduced ordering frequency (from 113 to 33 orders per year).

research_insights.selected_model: Combined Variance EOQ with Storage Constraint
research_insights.selection_rationale: EOQ optimized for annual demand of 120469 units, constrained by storage capacity of 4512 units and MOQ of 1068 units. Safety stock calculated using combined variance formula for demand and lead time uncertainty.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity is the binding constraint, limiting order quantity optimization.
